## Known divergences in later CPython versions

- `PyModuleDef_Slot.Py_mod_gil` (CPython 3.13): Python 3.13 adds the Py_mod_gil module slot and its stable-ABI constants. Source: <https://docs.python.org/3.13/c-api/module.html>
- `PyGILState_Ensure` (CPython 3.14): During interpreter finalization, Python 3.14 hangs the calling thread instead of terminating it. Source: <https://docs.python.org/3.14/c-api/init.html#c.PyGILState_Ensure>
- `object-header.immortal-refcount` (CPython 3.13): Free-threaded 3.13 builds add refcount and immortality behavior that must be accessed through public refcount APIs, not private header bits. Source: <https://docs.python.org/3.13/c-api/refcounting.html>
- `private-_Py-symbols` (CPython 3.13): Private _Py APIs may change without notice and several were removed or restored during the 3.13 cycle. Source: <https://docs.python.org/3.13/c-api/stable.html>
- `PyContext_AddWatcher/PyContext_ClearWatcher/Py_CONTEXT_SWITCHED` (CPython 3.14): Context watcher registration, notification and unraisable-error preservation are not implemented. The 3.14 Context C-API coordinate remains unsupported and release-held; other Context APIs do not demonstrate watcher support. Source: <https://docs.python.org/3.14/c-api/contextvars.html>

## Contract

The counts cover every exported C symbol discovered from `#[unsafe(no_mangle)]` declarations and the variadic shim export list, plus the structural layout, flag, and module-slot surfaces. Public symbols are conservatively classified as version-specific unless a stronger stable-ABI contract is explicitly represented; `_Py*` is private and `PyUnstable_*` is unstable.

The divergence list records 3.13/3.14 surfaces for future work; it does not claim support for those versions.
